description.value: Crumbs Bakery is a cafe and bakery located on Columbia Avenue in Castlegar, BC, a small city at the confluence of the Columbia and Kootenay rivers that serves as a gateway stop on several regional cycling routes. Based on OSM tagging it offers cafe-style food and coffee. No further details about the business can be confirmed due to its website domain appearing to have been compromised.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Crumbs Bakery as a cafe at 635D Columbia Ave, Castlegar, with cuisine tagged as coffee_shop — sufficient to categorize it as Food & Drink. However, the website fetched from https://crumbsbakerycafe.com/ returns content entirely unrelated to the business: it is an Indonesian lottery/gambling site called PEKANTOTO, strongly indicating the domain has been hijacked or allowed to lapse and re-registered by a third party. Because no legitimate website content is available, all amenity fields must be set to null; the contact_confirmed.website field is set to false due to the mismatch.
concerns: Website domain crumbsbakerycafe.com appears hijacked or expired and re-registered: fetched content is entirely from an unrelated Indonesian lottery site (PEKANTOTO), not from the bakery.
No phone number recorded in OSM.
Cannot confirm the business is currently open or operating without an alternative web source or direct contact.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business exists in OSM as an active cafe with no closure flag, but its registered website domain (crumbsbakerycafe.com) has been hijacked by an unrelated Indonesian gambling site (PEKANTOTO), making it impossible to verify current operating status, amenities, or contact details. A manual check is required before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Recommend reaching out to the business directly or checking local directories (e.g., Google Maps, Tourism Castlegar) to verify current status and obtain updated contact information before including in the WWC directory.
